description: Multi KPI Decomposition Tree Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All features included Complex hierarchical data rarely tells its full story through a single metric. The Multi KPI Decomposition Tree enables analysts and decision-makers to explore organisational hierarchies while tracking up to five KPIs simultaneously — surfacing the relationships that matter, at every level of the structure. Built for performance management, root-cause analysis, and cost attribution — anywhere hierarchy and multi-dimensional measurement intersect. Getting Started The visual accepts tabular data with hierarchy levels flattened into separate columns alongside their KPI columns. A sample .pbix file is available directly on this listing. In case of any questions, feel free to contact us immediately. Our dedicated Power BI Custom Visual team will be happy to assist you. Key Capabilities Stacked Bar Chart within Nodes — Visualise proportional breakdowns directly inside each node using embedded stacked bar charts. Up to 5 KPIs per Node — Display up to five simultaneous KPIs within each node for rich, multi-dimensional analysis at every hierarchy level. Multiple Formatting Options — Extensive formatting controls to tailor the appearance of nodes, labels, connectors, and KPI displays to your reporting standards.
